description: Registrul instalatorilor de sisteme fotovoltaice solare, Categoria B1 is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cristina Midoni. Contains information on solar PV installers that have been qualified and registered in the Register of SER Installers. Coverage: Cristina Midoni. The portal shows the English title as "Register of installers of solar photovoltaic systems, Category B1" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cristina Midoni. Its keywords include registru, instalatori, 2024, fotovoltaice. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
